claims: The Orion capsule for the Artemis II mission is named Integrity.
Integrity successfully completed its crewed lunar flyby mission.
Integrity splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on April 10, 2026.
Integrity was named to embody trust, respect, candor, and humility.
Integrity carried four astronauts around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed trip to the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II crew chose "Integrity" to represent the core values and dedicated team effort behind the mission.
Integrity completed a critical high-heat reentry through Earth's atmosphere on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Christina Koch, Victor Glover, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
Integrity featured a heat shield designed to withstand 5,000°F.
Future Artemis missions include the planned landing in 2028.
